dependency_edges.handoff: Preprocessed county totals and coordinates feed CA environments.
CA forecasts feed CI, maps, and threshold concern.
CA simulations feed RMSE parameter selection.
Census fields and county reports feed factor screening.
Selected k/m and factors feed modified CA.
Modified model feeds one-action strategy tables.
Strategy and limitation outputs feed memo/conclusion.

algorithm.convergence_criteria: No reproducible CA stopping rule, KNN seed, parameter-grid seed, multiple-testing control, or strategy monitoring rule is reported.
software: Python/Excel-like data work, county coordinate database, heat maps, CA/KNN calculations, ANOVA/correlation, and Appendix I RMSE grid are implied; no executable bundle was supplied.

assumptions: Treat NFLIS reports as usable but incomplete county observations, adjacent counties as relevant, historical patterns as predictive, and omitted counties as outside scope.
